result.summary: The page is largely well-designed with consistent spacing, typography, and color usage. One minor visual issue was found: the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated without an ellipsis, which is a cosmetic content-clipping concern at the card edge.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is cut off mid-word at the right card boundary without a trailing ellipsis, making the name look abruptly clipped rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol…') or reduce the font size / allow two-line wrapping so the restaurant name degrades gracefully at the card edge.
